sigma_method_details.estimator: Rolling-window correlation matrix of KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 daily returns
sigma_method_details.eigendecomposition: symmetric eigenvalue decomposition via base R eigen()
sigma_method_details.role_in_pipeline: AR_t is a SCALAR systemic-risk indicator, NOT a portfolio Σ. β_t emission only.
sigma_method_details.selection_rationale: Kritzman 2011 default K=5/W=252. Stress windows show clear AR concentration (GFC mean=0.485, COVID mean=0.408, Stagflation 2022 mean=0.393) vs normal mean=0.333. Stress robustness validated empirically. Single-cell selection per LRO 6-trial timeout pattern (no full sweep).
method_shopping_candidates_summary: K=1: market mode only — too coarse

eigenvalue_stability.interpretation: λ_1 dominance pct mean = avg market-mode share. Higher = more concentrated systemic risk. Stability via MoM change of λ_1.

absorption_ratio_summary.interpretation: AR_t mean 0.333 with sd 0.083 over 268 months. Range [0.180, 0.549]. GFC 2008 peak AR=0.547 (highest in series); COVID 2020 peak=0.529. K=5 captures ~33% of cross-sectional variance on average — consistent with KR market having a moderate-strength market mode (λ_1 dominance ~22%) plus 4 substantial secondary modes.

beta_t_overlay.description: scalar β_t ∈ [0, 1] gross exposure modulator; alpha-preserving

linear_band.warning: 59 months β=0 (full cash) — aggressive overlay. Forge should compare to threshold/sigmoid for severity.

threshold_step.note: Discrete 3-step. Mildest variant (no full cash). β floor = 0.4.

sigmoid_smooth.note: Smooth gradient. k = log(19)/(2σ_expanding). Symmetric around AR_med.

beta_t_overlay.forge_sweep_recommendation: Test all 3 variants; threshold_step likely lowest churn, linear_band most aggressive de-risking, sigmoid_smooth medium.

alpha_invariance_audit.mandate: rank_corr(w_STR1715, w_final / sum(w_final)) == 1.0 strict every rebalance month

mathematical_proof.statement: β > 0 scalar ⇒ w_final/sum(w_final) ≡ w_STR1715/sum(w_STR1715) ⇒ rank corr = 1 exact
mathematical_proof.derivation: w_final = β·w; w_final/sum(w_final) = (β·w)/(β·sum(w)) = w/sum(w). Identical post-renormalize.

empirical_verification.conclusion: ALPHA INVARIANCE MATHEMATICALLY GUARANTEED + EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED

alpha_invariance_audit.edge_case_beta_zero: β = 0 ⇒ w_final = 0 (all cash). No alpha exposure. Acceptable per mandate (cash residual = 1).
alpha_invariance_audit.audit_method_for_forge: For each rebalance month t with β_t > 0: compute spearman rank corr — must equal 1.0.

handoff_to_optimizer.package_role: RISK OVERLAY (not portfolio Σ for optimization)
handoff_to_optimizer.optimizer_action: Optimizer SHOULD NOT solve a fresh weight optimization. STR_1715 weights are FIXED inputs. Optimizer's role in this WT is to: (a) load STR_1715 production weights at each rebalance date, (b) load β_t from beta_t_mapping.csv (3 variants), (c) emit final weights w_final,t = β_t · w_STR1715,t with cash residual, (d) verify rank_corr == 1.0 strict per month, (e) hand to Forge for backtest sweep across 3 variants.
key_inputs: STR_1715 holdings.csv per-month ranking (for historical β_t application — Forge will need to re-derive for backtest months)
handoff_to_optimizer.method_recommendation: Forge sweep 3 variants × M4 schedule preserved. Compare vs STR_1715 base (no overlay). PASS criteria per request.json: CAGR ≥ 20% + MDD ≤ -25% OR -3pp + vol -20% + Sortino ≥ 1.0 + alpha_rank_corr == 1.0. Recommend threshold_step as primary (lowest churn, β_floor=0.4 conservative); linear_band as aggressive variant; sigmoid_smooth as smooth gradient. Recommendation_only WT — no book_state mutation.
